results.title: File a Consumer Complaint | US Department of Transportation
results.content:
If you feel that the airline does not resolve the issue to your satisfaction, you may want to file a complaint with DOT.  You may also file a complaint with DOT if you feel that you experienced unlawful discriminatory treatment in air travel by airline employees or the airline’s contractors on the basis of disability or on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex (including sexual orientation), religion, or ancestry.

## Safety and Security Complaints

Please note that aviation safety and security complaints are not handled by DOT’s Aviation Consumer Protection Division. [...] DOT will direct the identified airline and/or ticket agent to respond directly to you regarding your complaint. DOT will also require that a copy of the response be provided to it.
 Except for civil rights complaints, DOT does not investigate every air travel service complaint received due to the volume of complaints received. Instead, DOT conducts targeted or sample reviews of complaints to determine airlines' and travel agencies' compliance with aviation consumer protection requirements. [...] If you can’t resolve the problem at the airport, you may want to file a complaint with the airline.  DOT requires airlines to acknowledge consumer complaints within 30 days of receiving them and to send consumers written responses addressing these complaints within 60 days of receiving them.  DOT also requires airlines to let consumers know how to complain to them.

It’s often best to email or write to the airline’s consumer office at its corporate headquarters.  DOT requires airlines that fly to, from, or within the United States to state on their websites how and where complaints can be submitted.  There may be a form on the airline’s website for this purpose.

results.title: Hello Dot is a Quest 3 exclusive mixed reality experience made by Niantic
results.content:
"Hello, Dot, takes the best parts of caring for your adorable Dot companions and brings them to life through the magic of mixed reality. In this immersive experience, you’ll be able to admire just how visually stunning your Dots are up close, and develop a special bond with them as you play together.

Imagine being able to hook your hands under your Dot’s arms and pick them up – and then toss them up and let them float back down into your embrace. Or perhaps your favorite song is playing in the background and you want to have a little dance party with your Dot. Or maybe you want to just relax on the couch snuggled up against your Dot."

You can download Hello, Dot for free on the App Lab. My impressions will follow tomorrow.

CONTEXT & OPINION

## Niantic expands onto headsets [...] Niantic emphasizes that this is a showcase app, and I agree. Hello, Dot explores some of the more advanced but technically still limited mixed reality capabilities of Quest 3 and is primarily of interest to enthusiasts who are into this type of technology. But I don't think it's mature enough to be more than a gimmick, at least as far as pet simulations are concerned.

Hello, Dot requires the Quest 3's space setup feature and therefore only runs on the new headset.

1 [...] You can dip Dot into a bucket of paint and she will change color.
 You can command Dot to go anywhere in the room with a wave of your finger (and she obeys!).
 You can pick Dot up with your hands (which doesn't work very well).
 You can pet Dot and she will make sounds.
 You can feed Dot by conjuring up food with a gesture and dropping it on the floor, whereupon the pet will pounce on it.

More interesting than the interactions between the users and Dot are the interactions between the pet and the physical environment. Two features that I have rarely seen in other mixed reality apps are shadow casting (Dot casts shadows on the environment) and object occlusion (Dot is occluded by physical objects like a real sofa or wall). However, both effects are not very convincing.

results.title: Troubleshooting — Peridot Help Center
results.content:
#### Issue: Game doesn’t load

Reboot your device, and try again.  Make sure Passthrough is on and you’ve set up this Space in Space Setup

#### Issue: I want to start over again

You’ll need to turn off Meta Cloud Backup (Settings>General>Cloud Backup then Toggle Cloud Backup Off), remove App Data (Settings>General>Storage then navigate to Hello, Dot, highlight Clear App Data), then uninstall the App (Settings>Genera>Storage then navigate to Hello, Dot, highlight Delete). Then, turn on Meta Cloud Backup, and reinstall Hello, Dot.

#### Related articles [...] #### Issue: The laser pointer isn’t working properly and/or is pointing incorrectly

Please try either rebooting your device or restarting the app. Make sure Passthrough is on and you’ve set up this Space in Space Setup

#### Issue: The Arcade Machine isn’t in view or the Arcade Machine is far away/hard to reach

Please try clapping 3 times slowly, and dramatically. If that does not work, re-scan your space and restart your device.  Make sure Passthrough is on and you’ve set up this Space in Space Setup

#### Issue: My Dot keeps falling through the floor

Please try either rebooting your device and make sure your scan of your space is up-to-date

#### Issue: I can’t start my play date/the door won’t open

Please check to make sure your Arcade has enough Pawprints [...] Please check to make sure your Arcade has enough Pawprints

#### Issue: I have 0 Pawprints, but there are Pawprints all over the ground

Please grab the vacuum on the Right side of the Arcade and point the nozzle towards the Pawprints. They should get cleaned up in no time

#### Issue: All of the Pawprints are in the vacuum, but not in the Arcade

Attach the vacuum to the Right side of the Arcade

#### Issue: During customising my Dot, after speaking into the microphone, my paint bucket is black

This means the texture generated is Not Safe For Work. Please try another prompt

#### Issue: I can’t remove an accessory from my Dot

Shake your Dot, and it should fall to the floor. You can always just put a different accessory to remove it as well
